[[Category:Dungeons]]
[[sn:The Knocking Threshold]]Enter the enigmatic expanse of The Knocking Threshold, where the vastness of the Mirage Dunes cloaks a world teetering between the ancient and the extraterrestrial. Here, the Temple of Antibodies, with its deep-rooted mysteries, intermingles with the avant-garde construct of a crashed spaceship. As players journey through this unique realm, they are confronted with both internal and external battles, deciphering the interplay of long-standing beliefs and disruptive novelties.

== Background ==
Tucked beneath the deceptive Mirage Dunes, The Knocking Threshold emerges as a world split between two epochs: the long-forgotten Temple of Antibodies and an alien spaceship's wreckage. As these two entities converge, they offer players a symbolic canvas depicting the tug-of-war between deep-rooted convictions and the challenges posed by unfamiliar ideas.

== Location ==
The desert realm of Mirage Dunes, known for its ever-shifting sands and elusive mirages, veils the entrance to this dungeon. A ship is needed to pierce its vast expanse, leading adventurers to an alien vessel's remnants interlaced with the Temple of Antibodies in the O'Neill cylinder.

== Aspect ==
Holding a mirror to the antibodies' natural defense mechanisms and the Knock Aspect's penetrative prowess, the dungeon showcases the dual nature of safeguarding one's identity whilst allowing room for evolution and adaptation.

== Dungeon Item ==
The [[Knocking Hammer]] stands as a beacon of strength, enabling players to shatter barriers and unveil concealed chambers. Alternately, the Bombchus and Double Clawshots present themselves as tools to navigate through the dungeon's intricate confines.

== Key Object ==
The [[Alien Translator Device]], found early within the labyrinth, bridges the communication chasm, helping players unravel the alien scripts and decode the complex conundrums posed by the extraterrestrial tech.

== Midboss ==
The [[Alien Defender]], a sentinel of the celestial vessel, rises to challenge interlopers, reflecting players' natural defenses against foreign ideologies.

== Boss ==
Awaiting players is the menacing [[Entrapping Entity]], a creature embodying the oppressive nature of deep-seated biases and detrimental convictions, ensnaring intruders within the dungeon's walls.

== Dungeon Description ==
Within the heart of the Mirage Dunes, players journey through a realm where ancient stone merges with otherworldly metal, symbolizing the convergence of age-old beliefs and innovative paradigms. As the depths unveil, the alien influence amplifies, mirroring the complexity and depth of entrenched biases. The Alien Translator Device and Knocking Hammer become indispensable allies, navigating a world riddled with high-tech puzzles and eerie fusion architecture.

== Surrounding Location ==
[[Mirage Dunes]], a vast and treacherous desert, challenges wanderers with its capricious terrains and illusionary pathways, luring the unwary into its shifting embrace.

== Guardian Spirit ==
The regal [[Roc|Sand Gryphon]] reigns supreme over the dunes, guiding the deserving through Mirage Dunes' deceptive landscapes and granting clarity amidst the illusions.

== Exploration of Theme ==
Delving deep into themes of intrusion, The Knocking Threshold pushes players to introspect on the boundaries they erect against external influences. The intertwined spaceship and temple serve as battlegrounds for players to confront their prejudices, urging them to differentiate between genuine facets of their identity and externally imposed convictions.
*** '''Enhancements:'''
*** Illusionary Puzzles: Unmask the true nature of the desert's mirages to inch closer to the dungeon's gateway.
*** Spacewalk Sequence: Venture into the silent vastness of space, grappling with the isolation felt when scrutinizing one's inherent beliefs.
*** Blend-in Challenges: Mimic alien patterns to sidestep defense systems, emphasizing the art of adaptation.
*** Antibodies Enhancement: Navigate traps masquerading as beneficial tech, reinforcing the importance of discernment.
*** Rescue Challenges: Liberate NPCs ensnared by prejudices using both the translator and the Knocking Hammer, spotlighting the journey of emancipation from detrimental beliefs.

The Knocking Threshold, with its rich lore and intricate symbolism, immerses players in a world that compels introspection, challenging them to reassess their convictions and recognize the influences molding their beliefs.
